key_insight: EvolveNav adds test-time adaptation to zero-shot object-goal navigation by combining a self-updating rule memory with preflection to reduce repeated mistakes and inefficient exploration.
engineering_relevance: The framework is relevant for embodied AI systems that must operate in new environments without retraining, improving robustness through memory-based decision support and risk-aware action planning.
method: Extracts actionable rules from past trajectories into an agentic memory
Uses UCB-based retrieval to balance semantic match and past success
Adds a memory-guided preflection step to predict likely outcomes before acting
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong empirical gains over zero-shot baselines, including a 10.1% increase in success rate with fewer unnecessary steps.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and update stability of the learned rule memory, which may be sensitive to noisy trajectories or poor retrieval choices.
paper_title: EvolveNav: Proactive Preflection and Self-Evolving Memory for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation
